description:
Kim Ha-Kyung, a model student who is preparing for her college entrance exams this year, was initially skeptical of dating after hearing that dating would lead to ruin. However, she falls in love at first sight with Han Seung-Baek. However, Han Seung-Baek has a reputation as a troubled kid, and Kim Ha-Kyung becomes entangled in many situations afterward. To make matters worse, her childhood friend Kwon Gu-Min also expresses his feelings for her... 

Will Kim Ha-Kyung, who has embarked on a relationship that adults discourage, be able to grasp both love and reality?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
